generate_clrs_dataset_finite: create a finite Huggingface dataset from CLRS algorithm samples using clrs_generator with a fixed num_samples
generate_clrs_dataset_infinite: create an infinite IterableDataset from CLRS algorithm samples using clrs_generator without num_samples
generate_clrs_with_hints: generate CLRS dataset samples with hints included in questions and answers using the use_hints flag
generate_clrs_multiple_algos: generate CLRS dataset samples from multiple algorithms and input lengths in a single generator call
generate_clrs_custom_seed: generate reproducible CLRS dataset samples by setting a custom random seed in clrs_generator
